milestones.notes: module/crate system present from the first stable release
no GIL; Send/Sync enforced at compile time
Cargo has shipped with every official installer since 1.0
str/String are always valid UTF-8; no separate 'unicode mode'
type/lifetime generics from 1.0; const generics (min_const_generics) added 1.51; full const-generic expressions still incomplete as of the latest release covered here
async fn/await syntax; async fn in traits followed at 1.75; async closures remain unstable as of 1.98
tier 2 (Apple Silicon) at 1.49, promoted to tier 1 at 1.82
tier 3 at 1.32, tier 2 (prebuilt binaries) at 1.49, tier 1 at 1.91
prebuilt aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu binaries from ~1.9 (tier 2), promoted to tier 1 at 1.49
